label: Fires at GO after a rewarded S1 visit, more when belief favours S1.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (((tv("state", -1) == S1) & (tv("reward", -1) == 1)) * 1 + ((tv("state", -2) == S1) & (tv("reward", -2) == 1)) + ((tv("state", -3) == S1) & (tv("reward", -3) == 1))) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (ep_trial >= 40) * (ep_trial < 85) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None) ;; (phase == GO) * (belief_lo > 0) * (ep_trial >= 30) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("action", -3) == 1)
explanation: Very sparse feature (nonzero on 1.3% of steps), active only at GO and mostly in mid/late episode (timing baseline). Beyond timing it is raised after the previous trial reached S1 and was rewarded (strongest after rare a2->S1 rewarded), more with longer S1-rewarded streaks and S1-favouring belief; it is near zero after any S2 visit or unrewarded trial. But the magnitude is dominated by rare episodes where it sits at ~0.4-0.55 across a long run of a1/S1-rewarded trials, which these observed cues do not single out: most S1-rewarded GO steps stay at zero. The short form reaches only ~0.05 R^2 beyond timing on dev; the 7-term free fit (adding streak count, episode window and a1 repetition) reaches ~0.07, equal to the all-observed reference (ceiling all 0.16 with model outputs/hidden cues).
